title: Zoom - Service Degradation Affecting Zoom for Google Workspace add-on
text:
Service: Zoom
Incident: Service Degradation Affecting Zoom for Google Workspace add-on
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2026-09-01T11:57:41.000-07:00
Resolved: 2026-09-01T13:56:24.377-07:00
Updates:
- 2026-09-01T13:56:24.377-07:00: resolved - This incident has been resolved and the affected services have been restored.
- 2026-09-01T13:34:26.195-07:00: monitoring - The issue affecting a subset of users using Zoom for Google Workspace add-on has been resolved. 

Our team will continue to monitor the situation closely and keep you informed of any further developments.
- 2026-09-01T13:01:31.014-07:00: investigating - We continue to investigate the service degradation for a subset of users using Zoom for Google Workspace add-on.

We will provide an update as soon as more information becomes available.
- 2026-09-01T11:57:41.039-07:00: investigating - We are currently investigating a service degradation for a subset of users using Zoom for Google Workspace add-on

Our team is actively working to identify the impact and root cause. We will provide an update as soon as more information becomes available.

We appreciate your patience as we work to resolve this issue.
